crossRefs.note: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name…
The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.
“Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls…
Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the…
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to…
About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”
Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.
Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.
These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan…
All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

parallels.note: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.

people.name: Dan
people.line: Fifth son of Jacob, founder of Israelite tribe

people.name: Hushim
people.line: Son of Dan, ancestor of the Shuhamites.

translations.kjv: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
translations.asv: And the sons of Dan: Hushim.
